consequences: Quarantine dismissal does not erase source evidence or bypass policy. Saving corrected permitted information requires a new proposal through Gate. Missing/changed/noncandidate sources fail closed.
context: F16 lists active quarantine metadata but has no product disposition. Sensitive candidates cannot be released through low-disclosure review UI.
decision: Add owner-side BEGIN IMMEDIATE quarantine dismissal with full candidate/quarantine revision check, REJECT Gate audit and candidate/quarantine state changes in one transaction. A dedicated permission in the explicit five-minute review session allows only reject-and-dismiss; never direct release, approval or payload disclosure. Preserve disposition records and idempotent audit receipt.
title: Reject a quarantined candidate with atomic audited disposition
